alerts.name: PULBASE staging (1 DOWN, 2 RECOVERED, 3 NO DATA, 4 REVOKE, 5 RETRIES, 6 START, 7 LOGIN, 8 CREDIT)
alerts.description: Staging only. 1 service DOWN; 2 service RECOVERED (30 min); 3 no heartbeat (20 min); 4 incomplete revocation/check; 5 RPC retries >=10. 6 START, 7 LOGIN, 8 CREDIT: estimated technical failures >=3 AND failure rate >=20% over 20 min; expected denials/cancellations excluded. Priority 3 > 1 > 4 > 5 > 6 > 7 > 8 > 2. No traffic is not success. Counts are sampled estimates; no alert is not recovery proof. Every 5 min, repeat 15 min. Cost/usage alerts unchanged.
alerts.query: SELECT CASE WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'v1', 1, 0)) = 0 THEN 3 WHEN argMax(double1, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) >= 1 THEN 1 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'revocation-v1' OR blob3 = 'idle-revocation-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 1 THEN 4 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'revocation-v1', double4 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 10 THEN 5 WHEN sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-start-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 3 AND sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-start-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) * 5 >= sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-start-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) THEN 6 WHEN sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-login-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 3 AND sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-login-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) * 5 >= sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-login-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) THEN 7 WHEN sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-credit-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 3 AND sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-credit-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) * 5 >= sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-credit-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) THEN 8 WHEN argMax(double6, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) > 0 AND argMax(double4, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) - argMax(double6, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) < 1800 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20' MINUTE
